I know how much of my time my page takes and I'm a tiny little minnow in a huge pond. Instagram has made me some amazing friends, it's supported me through some really dark days and it's given me the opportunity to be myself and spread my message. Did I ever tell you how I picked my name? I was performing as a drag king at the time. It was a place where I could put my theatrical background to use in an accessible context, and I loved getting dressed up “like a man.” I would stipple on a beard and mustache and stare at myself in the mirror, imagining I was looking into the future. I didn’t have the words to really explain that I knew I was trans... I just loved the feeling of binding and swaggering and making a mockery of masculinity while also reveling in it.
.
I finally had my breakthrough performance, with the club crowd cheering and on their feet. The drag queen hosting the show came onstage and wrapped her arm around my shoulder, her sweat pooling against my neck. The lights were hot and her voice in the mic was loud. We were both flushed with the energy of performance and she asked me what my name was. I was flustered for a moment and she clarified, so everyone could hear: “Your DRAG name, sweetheart!”
.
I didn’t have a drag name. I’d never thought about it. Everyone was looking at me, still buoyed by our shared experience of drag and dance and staying up late and club lights. My brain went completely blank, and suddenly my eyes fixed on a friend of mine who was in the crowd. In a panic, I said his name into the mic.
.
“Trystan,” I blurted out. “My name is Trystan.” And everyone started calling me Trystan. I chose that specific spelling a little later on, opting for a derivation of the root word “tryst,” which of course means a romantic interlude or a date with a lover. Being called Trystan felt right in a way not much did at that time. It felt like home immediately, and within a few months I had formally asked my friends to use it full-time. My family came later.
.
It’s not a clean story. I didn’t plan it out or think it over. It came to me in a flash, like so many things do. And I’ve loved it ever since.

I was in the car today with Biff when the new Death Cab song came on. “Oh!” I said. “We love this song!” And then I corrected myself right away. “I mean, I love this song. I don’t know how you feel about it.”
.
I couldn’t figure out why I was so scared to say “we” until I remembered. A couple of years before meeting Biff, I had a serious boyfriend. Except he wouldn’t let me call him my boyfriend. He wouldn’t let me call him my anything. I don’t know if he was embarrassed to be dating a trans guy or if he knew we weren’t really meant to be together or what, but every time I tried to solidify things or make us a “we,” he just panicked.
.
And you know how he broke up with me? He came to visit me in New York when I lived there, and then went to have dinner with a friend... and NEVER CAME BACK. He didn’t call or text or in any way tell me what was up. I thought he was dead. To this day, he has never given me any explanation for his disappearing act.
.
When this picture was taken, I was trying to be cute but I was still completely confused and devastated. What had I done wrong? Had I been so bad at dating that I didn’t even warrant a break-up letter? Had he found someone else who was more fun than I was? Cuter? Easier to be with?
.
Friends— when someone won’t be with you publicly, it’s a sign. They don’t deserve to be with you privately. Dump them already.
.

Happy Friday! I’m Jenise, the face behind the keyboard here at A Toddler & A Topknot. I’m a wife to a hubby who I don’t know what I would do without @esoob84 😍 and Mom to two little ones I adore more than anything. I love sweets 🍫 and coffee ☕️ and on occasion, wine 🍷. I woke up this morning to an interview published by @voyagemiami where they grouped me with trailblazers in Miami (You can read the interview via the link in my bio). For the record, I don’t think I’m a trailblazer. I think I’m a Mom who did what she had to do to make it work. The fact that so many of you like what I say is just a really huge bonus. I always loved to write, but I didn’t go for it because I thought journalism was the only way to do that. I became a teacher, and I loved it, and I honestly thought I’d be doing that forever. I got to speak in front of a group of students this week, and one of the things I told them was, “If you had asked me even five years ago if this is where I thought I would be, I would have told you ‘no way,’ but a little voice in my head kept urging me to write. So I did. And this thing just grew and grew.” I’m not sure where it’s going or how long it will last, but I’m enjoying the ride, doing something I love, and helping others in the way I know how. My point is, if there’s a voice in your head telling you to do something, follow it. Start small. M O T H E R H O O D
Is trying to make a bottle, entertain a toddler, whilst making lunch & answering the door. I may still be in my pjs  and I can’t remember when I last brushed my hair but I did manage a cuppa today and I’ve half prepared a @slimmingworld lasagne for tonight which in my book is a success when you have one child let alone with two. 
What a weekend we had... So looking after them on my own would have been fine except E got a temp and had a fever convulsion which is apparently quite common - scared the life out of me as it’s like a seizure. It’s horrible to see your child poorly but I really wasn’t prepared for her to fit. I called 999 in a mad panic with Jacob screaming and they assessed her and helped bring her temp down. We had a near miss with the hospital because of it but managed to stay at home. Luckily my sister came to the rescue to help out just in case. Sunday however she dipped again so we took her to the out of hours GP - turns out she has tonsillitis hence the temp! Hubby decided to come home too as he was worried. So safe to say this cuppa is deserved! On the plus side my tooth troubles have subsided and E is on antibiotics and getting better each day. #dayslikethese

.

.
When I’m focused on Christ, my heart & mind  are clear to hear from him. My decisions, creativity, interactions, leadership, relationships, & business have flourished since this shift in focus.
.
Why? I know I’m not the only one who struggles with controlling their mouths & what they choose to focus on or where hearts tend to wander. Thankful that we have a savior who chooses to redeem us, make us new and is our steadfast and ever faithful rock, our confidence & place of rest!

I’m a little late for #transformationtuesday, but that’s because I went looking in the attic for old photos of myself and fell down the rabbit hole of memories. Boy, did I find some gems that you’ll be seeing in future posts!
.
This is one of my all-time favorite pictures of me as a kid. I think I’m around four years old and I guess you would have called me a tomboy, although we didn’t really use words like that in our house growing up. We didn’t have hugely gendered expectations put on us (as you can see from the photo). I don’t remember pulling bows out of my hair or cutting up dresses late at night. I was allowed to wear what I wanted (including overall-shorts with no shirt, apparently), do what I wanted (including sports, climbing trees, and dance classes), and express myself however I wanted (everyone’s opinion was welcome).
.
I honestly think that’s why I came out relatively late, compared to when trans youth today have their own revelations. There wasn’t much to rebel against, until my body started changing and the world responded. “Kid” is practically its own neutral gender, while “young woman” is another thing entirely.
.
I think this “transformation” is not a #glowup at all— I love the young photo of me, genderless and small. Bandaged knees. No forced smile. Just... a kid, free of the world’s expectations. Present and perfect. I am different now, but not better. Older, yes. But not better. Just... different.
.

✨TODAY IS THE DAY✨ Presets release at 7PM EST! As silly as it sounds, there has been tons of emotion surrounding this decision and development. I shared a little bit in my stories on Tuesday about what 2018 was like for our family. Amidst bringing home a new baby, my husband lost his business which spiraled into us losing our home and moving in with my parents. The weight of financial crisis is absolutely crushing and debilitating. Feelings of defeat and exhaustion, confusion and doubt have been a common theme. Not knowing what our next steps were has felt really overwhelming at times. Bouts of depression and anxiety have reared their ugly head. Negative thoughts stampedes. Tears of frustration. Anger and resentment. Little by little, jobs started coming in for me that I couldn’t have orchestrated in my own strength and with my on-call contracts, it didn’t make sense for my husband to go and find a 9-5 because these jobs were requiring me to be away for unknown amounts of time and someone needed to be with the kids. It’s been a song and dance of sorts and figuring it all out has been anything but easy. Today is so much more more than me just selling my presets, today is a big step in further developing my photography/media business and generating income to help support my family. I have so many dreams and desires in my heart that 5 years ago I never would have even thought about. As a photographer, I am passionate about documenting stories through my lens and I do it with my whole entire heart. As a mama, I am passionate about capturing our daily life and CHOOSING to remember the joy + beauty despite the challenges and struggles we face. I don’t do it to make it look like my life is perfect and I strive to be as genuine as I can be in this space. Instagram feeds + social media are highlight reels indeed but I’m a firm believer in the power of community and this space has brought some incredible relationships into my life and has brought opportunity in ways I never could have dreamed. There is always a choice to align our focus. Gratitude is a choice. (CONT IN COMMENTS)

One of the topics I am frequently asked about is the kids and their hand holding – maybe you’ve wondered about, too. 
I recall seeing another triplet mom holding one of her kids hands, while the 4 of them walked in a long chain.  I thought how amazing it would be if one day I could get my kids to do something like that.  It would make it so much easier to be able to take them out solo if they would just hold hands when we had to go places.  It really is a game changer when you have more kids than you have hands. 
I remember the first time I got them all to hold hands and walk together.  I clasped their hands together.  I held on and was walking with them and then I slipped my hand out and somehow they kept walking while my sister snapped about 1000 photos. 
I usually ask them to hold hands as we are leaving the car, telling them it’s for safety – which it is, but it is also pretty darn cute in my opinion. 
SO the answer is – they do hold hands when asked, and they usually don’t mind too much.  Beau has been known to demand that his siblings hold his hand, though… so if he is in the middle when you see them, there is a good chance he initiated it.

** Birth Story Part 1 ** Finally getting a chance to share my story as many of you have asked before and were interested in hearing. ❤ Hoping to ease some expecting mama's minds if they are scheduled for an induction. I want to share how it went and how I'm very happy with the process and that not all induction stories are horrible... mine surely wasn't. 
On the morning of 10/27/2017 I arrived, with my husband, at the hospital for our 7am induction (Pictured. My last bump photo at 40w + 4 days.) I was already about 2.5cm dilated with a soft cervix. I was hopeful, anxious, and a lot of bit hormonal.. I had already bawled my eyes out on the drive over to the hospital because we decided not to wake up Everly to have to explain we were leaving her today to bring home a new baby. We decided it would be easier to have her wake up with her Nana and Papa and just play all day and think we were just out and would be back soon. Either way I cried the whole drive over telling my husband we were horrible parents for not kissing her and telling her what we were doing and how her life was going to be changed forever, all of our lives were.. I was so blinded by my tears I even yelled at my poor hubby thinking he was going the wrong way through a traffic circle.. he wasn't. Smart man drove me to our nearest Dunkin' Donuts to get me a bagel and to bring our nurses a dozen donuts for having to deal with my psychotic self. So back at the hospital, I finally cooled my jets & by the time they hooked me up with IVs/fluids, etc the pitocin kicked in around 9am. I had very bearable contractions throughout the morning and when they checked me before noon I was about 4cm dilated. Me and my doctor were both on the same page where we wanted to break my water once contractions got pretty steady as we did this when I was pregnant with Everly and that's when things really got moving. So she did that just after 12- it doesn't hurt in the least bit, just so warm and literally feels like you are peeing all over the place. I was somewhat reclined in the bed so as I sat up more water came out, I giggled, more water. I waddled myself to the bathroom.. (continued in next post)

I AM Chantelle Nelson of Calgary, Alberta🇨🇦
I have lived in Northern California for the past 4 years. I am a wife to the most wonderful man, @dontanelson, and a mom to my son, @ziondupree, who both literally make my heart want to explode because I love them so much❤️❤️❤️. I love coffee... like LOOOVE coffee☕️☕️☕️. I often drink 3 cups a day and it’s the very first thing I do every single morning. I love clothes. I love fashion👠👚. I love buying new shirts and being excited to get dressed everyday. Brunch is my favorite meal. Going out for brunch is one of my favorite things to do - coffee, fluffy pancakes, and the buzz of good conversation: it’s an unbeatable combination🥞☕️. I love to exercise. I don’t just do it cause “it’s good for you,” but I genuinely enjoy the adrenaline rush and the next-morning-burn💪🏼. My love languages are words of affirmation and quality time. I love deep and meaningful conversation and I hate small talk. I’m an INFJ and an Enneagram 3, which means I’m super driven, incredibly efficient, intuitive, hard working, sensitive, and I crave meaning and purpose. I love reading - I usually have 3 or 4 books on the go at any given time and I always finish every book I start📚. I’m a psychology nut. I love learning all about how and why we do what we do and think. I used to watch psychological documentaries before bed every night (until they started messing with my dreams🤪). I love learning and research. I google the definition of words on a daily basis and have a minimum of 20 tabs open on my phone browser at any given time. I love writing. I didn’t know I was actually gifted at it until my husband told me a couple years ago. I love God. He saved me from my mess and I’m thankful for his redemptive grace every single day. 
I love my life and myself - I never used to - but I do now. It hasn’t always been easy. I’ve worked really hard on myself. For years, I had no clue who I was, what I liked, or what I was good at. This👆🏼is me exploring some of that and sharing it with all of you in hopes that it will inspire you to also discover and love who you are!

I think I am too worried about them running through and trampling all of the beautiful flowers, plus it is challenging to get to them if they are misbehaving, as I am also trying to be cautious about where I walk.  Regardless, this is one of our springtime traditions and it means that warm weather isn't too far off for us.
.

Protecting the hands that matter the most. My children's skin is already sensitive as it is, so it's an important factor for me to find products that will keep their skin safe and not cause irritation. Plus it's a bonus when you find a product that smells amazing to them as well, because this beauty smells absolutely amazing! As you're washing your hands you can smell the fresh lemon and eucalyptus. It does an amazing job at neutralizing any odor. Believe me, I know without a doubt. Lathers beautifully. Best of all it doesn't leave your hands feeling dry and rough. Leaves no residue, just clean hydrated hands. My family loves this soap and we've become fans of this brand. We will definitely be checking out their other products. We might need to get our hands on a few more things.♡

I had the pleasure of taking to my first new mom of a chromosomally enhanced baby last night. It was one of the best things I've done in a while. I was so nervous to do it, I didn't want to overwhelm or scare her because I wanted to be honest with all my answers. When you have a baby and find out it has Down Syndrome it is the scariest thing. When we were told when she was born I can say I didn't care, I wished the doctor was wrong, but I was more worried about how others would treat her. Well today we went to our first ever social play group at a local dance studio. Teagan didn't do what the other kids did, but she had SO much fun. She sat in the middle of the circle dancing and laughing just taking it all in. And everyone loved her! Yes I got in my car and cried, she has typical friends that we see somewhat often and I see the differences in development, but her being with complete strangers today was so good for her, but also really made me realize that yes she is delayed. And it's okay and NO one cared ❤️

The product has Marine Algae Complex, which helps hydrate and soften your skin.  The outer layers of the skin's surface will be moisturized, helping to prepare the skin for your mask to work optimally, and it even helps the mask apply more smoothly.  I'll be using this before every mask I use for now on!

10 weeks with this sweet girl & finally starting to feel like myself somewhat again + the weather is getting nicer and I just feel so much relief. I spent the last month debating whether or not I was experiencing PPD symptoms & finally talked with my doctor about it. I didn’t experience any of these feelings after Kadence or Maverick and it was such a foreign feeling for me. I started feeling inadequate basically right after my sister left. How was a supposed to function completely exhausted, be a mom to two other kids, take care of the house, cook & be a wife? I was starting to think that this was just the reality of having three kids. I honestly felt incapable and so overwhelmed with something that has always come so easy for me. I kept thinking I would just snap out of it — but I got to a point where I just cried and cried, I snapped at my kids/husband more times than I’d like to admit & leaving the house sounded absolutely awful. I honestly don’t want to talk much about it and I’m just taking it day by day, hour by hour — but I wanted to share my thoughts and feelings just in case anyone else is dealing with this. Tell a friend. Tell your husband. Tell your mom. Tell your doctor. This is motherhood & it’s so hard, but you are a good mom and know that you are not ever ALONE in this journey.

A veces el ser humano es tan complicado que necesitamos conocer historias así para poner los pies en la tierra y valorar cada pequeña cosa que tenemos, Lo afortunados que somos y @villagayumbos con su viaje también nos está mostrando que por poco que seamos podemos hacer grandes cosas. El ser humano es capaz de soportar gran dolor, grandes miserias y aun así hay mucha gente que sabe buscar la luz en todo eso.
Qué afortunada me siento de todo lo que tengo y de todo lo que no ha llegado aún. Afortunada de tener gente así que me hace abrir los ojos y dejar de mirarme el ombligo para darme cuenta de que mis problemas y preocupaciones son tan pequeñas como lo somos nosotros, porque muchas veces nos creemos que nuestras tragedias son únicas, enormes e insoportables y de pronto cambiando la perspectiva te das cuenta de que lo tienes todo a tu alrededor y no lo sabías o habían perdido valor, porque nos acostumbramos. Igual que hacemos de lo malo el drama, hagamos de lo bueno una fiesta party hard.

We are truly lucky in Queensland we have so many wonderful National Parks available to us like Girraween National Park. Located on the Granite Belt just a few hours drive from Brisbane.

4 years ago the Lord told me, "Just do what's in front of you and I'll take care of the rest." Yesterday, while sharing what we were thankful for around the dinner table with friends, I realized that I'm living my dream. The long list of things that I've dreamed of and hoped for my entire life are all coming true. But the beautiful thing is, I haven't had to fight my way to see them happen. I've literally just set my eyes and my heart on what is right in front of me and when I take a look behind and around me, I realize that everything is falling into place and is better than I ever dreamed it could be. 
The last 6 years have been some of the toughest years of my life, but looking back, I'm so thankful. I'm thankful for the pain. I'm thankful for the process. I'm thankful for the pruning, the stretching, the shaping, and the molding. I wouldn't be who I am today without it all. 
I've had to choose to believe that God IS who He says He is. I've had to choose to believe that the dreams in my heart are actually from Him. I've had to choose to believe that He is faithful to fulfill what He has promised me. In the face of fear, anxiety, and disappointment, I have had to fight to believe that God has more for me than I could ever dream up myself. 
I wouldn't trade the pain for anything because it's given me my voice. It may have taken it away for awhile, but now - NOW I am going to speak louder than I ever have before because all these years have given me something to say! #livingthedream .

It’s hard being the middle child. I should know— I am one! Today Biff took Leo to the museum while I worked, and then we met with the entire support team at Riley’s school to try to figure out a path forward for him there. He is such a sweet kid but his behavior has been spiraling. Everyone in the meeting was so positive and solution-oriented, and I came away feeling like everyone was as committed as we are to figuring out what he needs to be successful.
.
But sometimes I look at our sweet middle child and hope she’s getting enough from us. With a baby on one side and a big brother will big needs on the other, I hope she knows how adored she is.
.
Tonight I read her a chapter like always and I kissed her forehead and made her repeat after me: “I’m brave. I’m strong. I can do anything.”
.
Just in case anyone out there ever tried to tell her otherwise.

We will forever be pulled in different directions, we will always struggle with purchasing THINGS over prioritizing our health..... but we have to consider what is really going to affect the quality of our lives. 
Experiences are important but how much fun will they be if we aren’t well?

.

We chose to tell our story publicly so more lgbt people, especially trans people, could see how many possibilities exist for their futures.
.
I never believed I would find love or have a family— I didn’t think I deserved it. But Biff, Hailey, Riley, and Leo have shown me otherwise. And now we hope we can show you otherwise as well.
.

Reverse UV ray damage with a Coffee face/body scrub
______________________________

The benefits of coffee go way beyond morning pick-me-ups and beautiful aroma. Today I’ll share with you one of my favorite coffee hacks that have kept my skin bright and rejuvenated. Very easy and affordable!! why coffee? 💁🏽
Coffee in its purest form (no added preservatives) is a rich source of antioxidants that protect your skin from free radicals that age the skin. It basically reduces the skin’s aging process. The caffeine contained in coffee stimulates the skin and increases blood flow to the surface of the skin, this improves blood flow across the face and leaves the skin looking radiant and bright. It minimizes fine lines and protects against the loss of moisture from the skin as well as reversing the damage of UV rays. 
The additional ingredients peel away dead skin cells to promote tissue generation and the oil locks in the moisture, leaving the skin smooth and supple.

Ingredients:
2 tablespoons of coffee granules
2 tablespoons of brown sugar
1 tablespoon of virgin olive oil *mix ingredients well til they bind together to make a textured rub but be sure not to make it pasty*

Rub the mixture on clean skin in circular motions. Leave for 3~5mins and rinse off with cold water. Do this 2~3 times a week for best results.

N often only wants to nap in my arms, which can be tough. I just remind myself that this time is fleeting and that it is ok to snuggle him and enjoy it. So, sometimes he sleeps in my arms and sometimes I nurse him to sleep and that's ok!

So here's to another month of watching you grow. It's going by so fast. Watching my baby grow is the best gift I could ever receive.

Last weekend we visited the Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base in Fort Worth.  Before we left the base, we wanted to let the kids see an airplane up close.  All 3 had a good time playing underneath the plane, poking around in all of the wheels and flaps, but Wyatt in particular didn't want to leave.  I think he could have played under there for hours.  They all came out looking like mechanics, and were covered in dirt and grease head to toe.  The next time we go I will certainly plan more time for them to play and explore.  It's funny how we spend money taking them to all sorts of places and they could have wasted an entire afternoon just poking around and making memories on some old equipment.

.
So crazy, this second big chop has been so different from my first. I mean, this time around, I am more knowledgeable on what products work for my hair and what does not. That first big chop was me going from a relaxer to a Boosie fade then dyeing it bright red every three months. I had no idea what my hair in its natural state was like and had to learn. 😂👌🏾 Now, I’m not coloring my hair anymore - dyeing my hair black and allowing my natural color to fade in; I’ve found that healthiest for my curls. I am testing things I know may work for me and I am not as extra as I was with my first big chop years ago. 🙈 I was one of those who did hair mask every two days, used all these oils and products thinking I was a chemist - not anymore. Less has turned out to be more for me. I do two styles; my wash-n-go fro and this puff right here. 💁🏾‍♀️🙌🏾 I don’t think I will straighten it again either. I’m afraid of heat damage because I’m all about health. Because of this, thats where my wigs come in! 😅😂👌🏾 One of the main reasons I love glueless wigs so much is that they allow me to experiment and be innovative without ruining my own hair. I’m also ridiculously tender-headed and always miss my natural hair so I know a sew-in would work for me either. I’m Puffs and Wigs all year long. 😂

Dont ever and I mean EVER let somebody tell you what you can or can't do or that you're not enough! Babe, you're enough if you believe it yourself and work hard for your dreams!🔥
I'm been told so many times that im not talented enough, I'm ugly and fat queen who doesn't belong on stage or wear even a costume. There was a time when I was stupid and started to believe these comments and it was really hard for me to perform after that. BUT when i started to believe myself again and worked my ass of onstage, I got a message of one of these haters who came to apologize and said that I slayed the stage with my energy, that chainged it all for me!🌟
I'm enough, I'm beautiful and talented in my own unique way and that's enough!❤️
There will allways be people who don't like you and want to try to take you down but I say f*ck them! 
I will allways give my all when i am performing for you guys who cheer me up every day with your love and support!! I can't thank you enough for that!
I love ya so much and hope you all will pursuit your dreams no matter what it is, just believe yourselfs!💕

O carnaval chegando essa época é de muita folia. Mas não é por isso que os cuidados com os cabelos precisam ficar de lado,. Pensando nisso, o Ceiça Profissionais de Beleza reuniu dicas para você incluir na sua rotina durante o feriado e não deixar que as madeixas atrapalhem a diversão! •
•Dica 1: Usar sempre um protetor solar e hidratar bastante os fios. Por: @zildagomesmonteiro •
•Dica 2: Procurar usar produtos de reparação de pontas, óleos reparadores com proteção solar e proteção térmica e sempre estar com um Leave In. Por: @raimoliveira •
•Dica 3: Proteger o cabelo do cloro e do sal com protetores para cabelo pois o uso de produtos com agentes de proteção térmica e solar no cabelo é mais do que obrigatório no carnaval. Por: @alaydesabat •
•Dica 4: Usar shampoos e condicionadores que possuam proteção térmica e sempre hidratar bem os fios! Por: @valeriarodriguesrds •
•Dica 5: Usar muito óleo “Reflection” da Wella  como protetor térmico pois o produto forma uma película. Por: @danilodangeli_ •
•Dica 6: Usar creme de pentear quando for para piscina e não esquecer os protetores UV para os fios! Por: @luaraujomacedo •
•Dica 7: Os cuidados higiênicos após exposição solar e exposição a pó de carnaval, gel, glitter e sprays é muito importante! Um passo a passo ótimo é usar um óleo reparador com o cabelo seco mesmo, logo depois  desembaraçar os fios com os dedos e passar a escova de cabelo após feito esse procedimento use um shampoo, um condicionador ou hidrate com uma máscara para seu tipo de cabelo e para finalizar use um leave in de sua preferência! 
O cuidado para cabelos descoloridos, loiros ou mechados também é muito importante e a dica é evitar ao máximo piscina, pois altera o pigmento do cabelo! Por: @ceicademacedomatos •

Before my husband and I got together, annual vacations weren't a tradition for me. Whenever I got time off from work, I'd go and visit family or friends, but I never did the "away from it all" thing.

Terrence believes in taking a break. Every August, when his job slows down, we leave our home in search of R&R.

Sometimes we do a road trip, and go somewhere like Southern California or Oregon. Other times we'll go tropical in Hawaii or family friendly to Orlando. We take our kids with us, of course, and my in-laws are with us sometimes, too. Vacationing is a family affair!

What's funny is it took me awhile to get used to vacation. I was so used to being ON all the time that I didn't know how to turn off. Thankfully I have the hang of it now, and I count down the days until we can get away.

We're going to Germany in March for a break, and I can't wait. Even though it's going to be cold, and we're flying for hours and hours with a toddler, I know it'll be worth it to make memories and get away for a bit!

TRUTH: Students with Down syndrome are included in typical academic classrooms in schools across the country. The current trend in education is for full inclusion in social and educational settings. #磨人的小獅子

這篇也不算抱怨文，
應該算是媽媽的討拍文，
我家的小獅子真的讓我好崩潰，
問過有二寶的媽媽朋友，都有同樣的情形，
二寶是來折騰我的，
覺得這輩子的耐性都被他磨光了，
有時候看到他的笑容可能覺得，
嗯~世界還是非常美好，
但殊不知這只佔一天的20%，
其他80%不是哭就是呻吟，
依依嗚嗚啊啊大叫，非要站不要坐，
看到媽媽要人奶不要配方奶，
要討抱不要單獨自己玩，坐車哭睡覺哭，
吃不飽哭吃飽也會哭，
眼裡只有媽媽~只跟我耍任性，
其他人都不重要，
偶爾哥哥來逗我笑就好，
爸爸功能性等於零。

數數從台灣回來後，天氣變化大，
小咳大咳不斷，鼻水便祕一起來，
整天我只要顧著小湯包就好，
家事工作都無法好好處理，
這真的是我始料未及的，
24小時除了睡覺安撫陪玩餵食，
加上零碎家事，和照顧兩個大兒子，
我都沒有自己的時間，
有時候還得揹著湯包一起做事，
你說我快樂嗎？其實~是的，
看到三個男人還是挺幸福，
但累嗎？媽的~~超級累，
想放空嗎？超級想~但誰來幫我顧？
尤其是阿班加班的時候(淚+累)，
以下省略一堆髒話。

終於懂為啥有些媽媽不想生二寶，
或是生完有憂鬱症了，
大家都辛苦了，
看著#小班班 嬰兒時期，再對照小湯包，
說不失控是假的，但我苦中作樂，
至少班哥還算乖，
把自己自理得還不錯，還會幫忙照顧弟弟，
這點讓我很欣慰啦！
至於 #我是小湯包 會讓我崩潰到什麼程度，
讓咱們繼續看下去吧！

“We ourselves feel that what we are doing is just a drop in the ocean. But the ocean would be less because of that missing drop.” -Mother Teresa 
I read this quote recently and it’s been on my mind since. It’s really easy to feel like we’re not needed, like we don’t have a place, or that we don’t bring anything to the table. I’ve thought that a hundred times over in several different circumstances. Then I started thinking about my tiny people. How I want them to always know there is a place for them, and greater than that... a NEED for them. Because we all have pockets full of experiences that someone else can learn from and have all been created for more good than we can comprehend. I want my little ladies to know they were made to try, to speak up, love generously, act courageously, learn immensely, and stand up for what they believe in. Maybe we’ve “only” been given a drop, but it’s up to us how big that drop will be. The next time the world tricks you into thinking you aren’t “something” enough, remember you’re contributing to a bigger picture. Keep contributing, keep fighting, keep filling the ocean with good.

I want to act more like my 3 year old daughter. I wish the way we see ourselves as kids can stay with each and every one of us into adulthood. Especially us ladies. I feel like we put SO much pressure on ourselves to look and act a certain way. Our girls are growing up in a world that's filled with picture perfect photos on social media and I feel like it's going to put unnecessary pressure on our sweet baby girls who will soon become little ladies and then young women to look a certain way, and have your hair this color, and your eyebrows this thick, and your body this fit etc etc. I want her to always see herself as beautiful and smart and amazing. I showed this photo to Everly just now and I said, 'Evie, don't you look so beautiful here?' and she looked at it, smiled and said, 'Wow, YUP, I'm beautiful!' without a second thought. No picking herself apart like I know I would do if I saw a portrait photo of myself. And in that sense, I want to act more like my 3 year old. I want to have the confidence she has in herself. So, I'll work on being kinder to myself and my body and hope that she can see the way I treat myself and others around me and will grow up always thinking, 'Wow, I AM BEAUTIFUL.' Una de las cosas que más quiero para mis hijos, es que puedan vivir una vida en paz. Creciendo, nos vamos llenando las manos y la mente de cosas innecesarias, tanto materiales como abstractas. Lo hacemos porque creemos que así seremos "más felices" o porque así seremos "personas de éxito" (lo que sea que eso signifique), pero la realidad es que nada de eso vale si no tenemos paz y no estamos felices con lo que hacemos y tenemos.
.
Con @joselarabayer tratamos frecuentemente de re-evaluar la vida que llevamos y de considerar si las decisiones que tomamos van de la mano con el estilo de vida que queremos llevar: ¿vale esto el gasto de tiempo? ¿de dinero? ¿de enegía?
.
Cómo ya les he compartido, estamos felices en @seedshabitat precisamente por eso. El método montessori promueve un día a día sencillo pero enriquecedor para los niños. No hay sobre estimulación, sino aprendizaje con propósito, con sentido, al ritmo del niño y aplicable en la vida real.
Aún queda una semana del curso fe vacaciones, pero especialmente les recomiendo considerarlo como opción de preescolar para sus hijos. Un millón de veces, con los ojos cerrados.

Every night we give this kid a back rub. Every. Night. It’s supposed to help us develop a stronger bond with him, repairing some of the attachment that was shattered in his developing psyche as a toddler experiencing trauma. And I’ll be honest... I don’t love doing it. I would rather talk or play or read to him. He is forever bossy and demanding. “No, don’t RUB my back. I want you to scratch it lightly. Good. Now do the skin roll. Dada does it better than you do but it’s okay.”
.
Eye roll. Every time, it’s like I’m parenting all of my ex-boyfriends at once. But of course, he’s a child. At ten he seems so big but really... he’s a child. And when he’s 12 or 15 or 18 and doesn’t want this nightly ritual anymore, I know I’ll miss it. So I do what the therapist tells me and I rub his back (no, I lightly scratch his back before doing the skin roll thing). And I think about that time we backpacked to the waterfall and dream of all the other adventures we are headed for.
.

All of my life people have told me, “oh you should model,” “you’re so tall why don’t you model?” Here’s the thing....
•
•
8 years ago I tried to dip my toes into the modeling industry. At the time, I thought I had what it took, I thought I could handle being told what to do. I thought I was moldable. And I am moldable. I’m ever evolving, BUT walking away from this was a CRUCIAL part of my evolution.
•
•
They wanted me to get down to an insanely unhealthy weight, told me I couldn’t eat bread, couldn’t have tattoos, couldn’t do this, that, etc. First of all, it should be noted that I do NOT do well with dietary restrictions, so ya girl was out immeJETly when they said that. In all seriousness though, I knew I would have been chewed up and spit out in that world. So this picture always brings up a lot of emotions for me because I think of where I could have ended up.
•
•
Was it a missed opportunity? Absolutely not. If I had pursued that, imagine everything I would have missed. I probably wouldn’t have my own business and be building another. I wouldn’t have realized I loved all the work that went on behind the scenes of a photoshoot and decided to pursue a career in the beauty industry.  I didn’t realize how defining of a moment that trip to LA in 2010 was, but now I do. And I appreciate it and wouldn’t change a thing. Trust your process, trust your journey. Every moment, every break down and break through is a stepping stone to getting you to where you need to be.

Fácilmente, esta foto podría ser yo hace 5 años. De viaje, sola, sin más preocupación para salir de paseo que pensar en mí: mi bolsa, billetera, ropa cómoda y tal vez si me preparé extremadamente bien, unos lentes y un pachón de agua.
Pero no, ahora soy mamá de dos niños y aunque mi esposo hace su parte, es increíble como somos las mamás las que pensamos en todo lo que una familia necesita para salir a aventurear: Snacks? Listo. Ropa de cambio? Listo. Pachones de agua? Listo. Bloqueador? Listo. Cobertor de lactancia? Listo. Cargador para bebé? Listo. Carruaje? Listo. Juguetes para bebé e hijo mayor? Listo. Blusa de cambio para mamá (por aquello de los accidentes)? Listo. Suéteres? Listo. Y esto es solamente lo que se ve...las cosas tangibles.
Pero además sabemos que somos su seguridad, las que podemos calmarlos, las que sabemos los trucos para que no se aburran y estén entretenidos, las que sabemos qué comida pedirles en los restaurantes, las que estamos pendientes de sus horas de siesta, de llevarlos al baño antes de subirnos al carro, de que el pañal esté limpio, medicinas...
Hoy fuimos a uno de mis restaurantes favoritos y estaba LLENÍSIMO. Nos tocó una mesa super apretada y decidí pedir pizza. No les voy a negar que me encanta, pero lo hice también porque sabía que era lo más fácil de comer con una mano (en la otra cargando a mi bebé). Al terminar, me salí un momento con él y lo llevé cerca de una fuente porque estaba ya muy cansado; fue un momento relajante para los dos. Casualmente, me topé con otra mamá calmando a su hijo de año y medio tal vez; no nos dijimos nada. Simplemente nos vimos, sonreimos, ella corrió su carruaje y yo me pude acercar más al agua: nos entendimos y eso fue suficiente.
Esto de ser mamá es lo más lindo de la vida, pero hay taaaaaanto que no se ve (y a veces puede llegar a ser tan extenuante). Que en este mar de peces en los que todos vamos nadando en distintas direcciones sin muchas veces detenernos a pensar en los demás, agradezco por aquellas mamás que se detienen y simplemente sonrien y corren su carruaje para hacer un espacio.
¿"Super mujeres"? Por supuesto. Desde su trinchera, grande o pequeña, las abrazo y sobre todo: las veo.

Wednesday mornings are the craziest for us. I need to have all 6 of us ready and out the door before 8am. I usually feel like a crazy person by the time we walk out the door but in an attempt to make this morning go a bit smoother we packed lunches and set out clothes last night. While the kids were sleeping I woke up early (I’ve been doing this lately to have time to myself for my own personal study). But even still, for no particular reason, I woke up in such a blah mood. I hate that, when you have all the right intentions but you just feel...blah and grumpy and you don’t know why. So I read, found quotes that helped me feel better and wrote down a few affirmations determined to kick my weird mood. It worked (I love when that happens) and before we walked out the door I was able to snap this pic. Trying my best to kick my weird moods more and focus on the good because there is just so, so much of it!

On Friday, one of my 6th grade students asked me if I was pregnant. I gave him a little grace since he wasn't in our school last year, he obviously didn't see me pregnant. I told him I had a baby 8 months ago & gave him a very important lesson:NEVER ask that question. 
I was proud that I didn't let that moment depress me, but rather motivate me. My postpartum journey is my own. Yes I'm back in my old clothes, but my old clothes sometimes makes me look 3-4 months pregnant. I'd love to slim all the way down, but I've got alot to juggle right now. I work full time as a school counselor, my hubby is an entrepreneur/farmer, we're raising 3 kids, and I'm building my own brand too.
Mama, don't let anyone rush the process for you--not even yourself. Let's let go of judgement & give each other more grace. And I challenge you to see how someone is really doing. If they give you a half hearted I'm fine, press them. Love on them . Instead of giving more gifts, lets share more of our hearts.

What do you use on Savannah's curls?
.
I get asked this question pretty frequently. I have heavy waves, so I've long been interested in how to make them be more manageable. Years ago I read an article that said curls love conditioner and from my perspective, I agree.
.
It's been over a year since we discovered traditional baby/kid products just weren't for Savannah. Her curls were getting pretty frizzy. We switched her to adult conditioner. I'm not very brand faithful for shampoo and conditioner, I'm afraid to say. If I find a good deal at @ultabeauty I just stock up. But I'm talking nice products, no drugstore products. So Savannah uses whatever I'm using at the time.
.
If she has tangles, we comb through  them during bath, with the conditioner in her hair. We pat her curls dry after bath, not getting overly aggressive with the drying.
.
In the morning we use leave in conditioner. I've tried lots of brands, but I love It's a 10 silk express miracle doing leave in @itsa10haircare.  This stuff isn't cheap, so I bought the conditioner and refill the bottle with a few pumps and then the rest water and it works great. We comb through her hair in the morning, never brushing. If we can get through it with fingers and no comb, it's even better. And finally for the best curls a morning shower (or just a quick rinse) is really the best before the leave in, but that rarely happens.
.
That's it... Conditioner.... no big earth shattering secrets here.

❗️Anketa zda máte vždycky děti připoutané v MHD v kočárku není samozřejmě jen tak 🤷🏻‍♀️ A jsem moc ráda že většina dává ano 🙏🏻 .
.
Před pár dny jsem jela MHD a viděla opět maminku s kočárkem ve kterém nebylo dítě připoutané, o tom jak další maminka kojila za jízdy miminko ani nemluvím 🙏🏻.
.
A tak jsem se rozhodla se s váma podělit s naším pro mě nejhorším zážitkem na který v životě nezapomenu a děkuju všemu co můžu, že se nic nestalo 🙏🏻 .
.
Bylo to v létě, když začalo teplo. Jela jsem koupit bazének na balkón aby se Leontýna mohla vykoupat a po cestě zpět domů natěšená s bazénkem asi tak 200 metrů před naší zastávkou autobus prudce zabrzdil aby se vyhnul srážce s dalším autem. .
Lidi okolo mě i já jsme spadli na zem, ale kromě mě spadl i můj kočárek s Leontýnou uvnitř 😞 kočárek se prostě převrátil na zem na bok a spadl jako nic🙈 Leontýna začala  brečet, lidi mi pomáhali zvednout kočárek, vyndat brečicí Leontýnku, já hystericky brečicí ač jsem se pomalu neudržela na třesoucich nohou jsem jí křečovitě držela v ruce se strachem že se jí neco stalo.
.
Po telefonním hovoru kdy jsem nebyla v slzách schopná patrikovi říct co se děje byl doma do pěti minut a jeli jsme do nemocnice, naštěstí Leontýna díky tomu, že byla připoutaná byla naprosto v pořádku 🙏🏻🙏🏻 o mých modřinách po obličeji a po celém těle, o zníčeném kočárku nemluvím. .
Ten strach jaký jsem měla o malou bych nikomu nikdy nepřála a proto vás prosím dokud jezdíte s kočárkem v MHD mějte děti připoutané 🙏🏻 nedovedu si představit tu samou situaci v hluboké korbě nebo v případě, že by nebyla připoutaná 🙈 a opravdu děkuju tomu co je někde nahoře, že se leontynce nic nestalo 🙏🏻 .
.
Taková @_jane_laur  Když jsme se krátce potom potkaly a já měla jěste modelinu pod okem si myslela, že mě doma mlátí 😅 .

Intanto vado a sistemare i miei fiori nel vaso e mi perdo un po’ nel loro profumo terapeutico...voi che fate?

Ya pasamos la etapa de newborn pero el porteo es (nuevamente) parte de nuestro día a día. Nuestro amigo para las siestas, malestares, o para cuando mama tiene mucho que hacer. Nos acompaña en nuestros paseos, trámites y mandados.
Además fortalece su espalda, cuello y ayuda a reducir el problema de "cabecita plana" que a veces se da en los bebés. Ayuda a su digestión, promueve la lactancia y el cargador adecuado (usado correctamente) no afecta el buen desarrollo de su espalda, la cual debe estar en forma de "C" cuando son bebés.
Amarrarlo bien es la clave, y requiere de práctica, pero así es con todo...No crean, al principio también me costaron los amarres y mantener la posición correcta. Colita más abajo que rodillas, espalda en "C", cabecita "besable" fácilmente (el bebé tiene que estar colocado más arriba de lo que creemos).
Ay días de porteo...¡qué alegre es tenerlos de vuelta en mi vida! Pasan tan rápido ♡
**la tela del hombro debe ir sobre el hombro y no caer, para que quede bien sostenido. Aún tengo que mejorar eso 😅

.

S.O.S Sommer Paket von @nuggbeauty 
Ein tolles Paket hat mich letztens erreicht und zwar mit drei verschiedenen Masken von @nuggbeauty. Alle Masken sind ideal für beansprucht Haut im Sommer. Denn auch im Sommer wird die Haut durch Hitze, Sonne und Wasser strapaziert. Die Detoxifying (schwarz) mit Oatmeal Extrakt beruhigt die Haut und reinigt sie, für einen matten Look. 
Die Exfoliating Maske ( rot, mitte) hingegen hilft gegen Unreinheiten und verstopfen Poren, die durch verstärkte Talgproduktion bei Hitze entstehen. 
Meine Lieblingsmaske ist die Hydrating ( rosa, rechts). Sie ist feuchtigkeitsspendend und beruhigt die, durch die Sonne, beansprucht Haut. Diese habe ich heute benutzt. Meine Haut fühlt sich nach allen Masken immer sehr gepflegt und weich an. Ich vertrage alle Masken sehr gut. Bei der Detoxifying Maske mag ich nur den Geruch nicht so sehr, da sie sehr stark nach dem Teebaumöl riecht. .
Der Inhalt reicht bei mir für zwei Anwendungen. Die Crememasken trage ich meistens dünn auf die Haut auf und lasse sie einige Minuten einwirken. Danach wasche ich sie gründlich ab. Die Masken gibt es bei Zalando.

Ogni volta che sono a Roma, nel mio ufficio che si affaccia sul laghetto dell'Eur, mi viene in mente quanta strada io abbia fatto grazie a tanti sacrifici.
E questa immagine, che adoro, #girlboss , racchiude ciò che sono diventata grazie alla tenacia.
Ho Camminato nelle stradine di un piccolo paese, sognando di girare il mondo. 
Ho indossato il vestito più bello, quello che gli altri mi avevano cucito addosso.
Ho percorso una strada lunga e difficile, che altri, con amore, mi avevano indicato ma che non sentivo tanto mia.
Ho preso la valigia tante volte e sono partita....da sola e in compagnia.
Ogni viaggio mi ha arricchita e mi ha aperto gli occhi.
Sono stata bianca, nera, gialla, povera e ricca, bionda e bruna.
Ho cambiato mille volte pelle ogni volta che cambiavo paese.
Ho imparato che riesco ad essere felice solo insieme a poche persone.
Ma soprattutto ho imparato chi sono.
E quando ho fatto questa meravigliosa scoperta ho capito quello che finalmente volevo essere....anzi ciò che sono: I AM A GIRL BOSS AND I LOVE IT❣

Is it what you thought? A few things to think about...these were all done in ONE session. So if split up over several sessions the cost would in the end be the same but be smaller installments. The first price isn’t an even number because it was a set service, whereas the second two are considered “corrective” or “creative” color and therefore charged per hour. I charge $100 per hour non negotiable for these services. I consider it a corrective or creative color when I am doing any or all of the following: lifting more than 5 levels, using vivids or pastels, decolorizing, correcting bands/bleed marks/ mistakes, unknown steps, etc. And lastly, be upfront about EVERYTHING. There’s nothing worse than going to pay your bill and getting slammed with a number you weren’t expecting, or having a expectation of a result and not getting it. Disclose the price ahead of time, and be HONEST!! If I don’t know how long something will take I say so, and also ALWAYS, and I can never say this enough, ALWAYS UNDERPROMISE, OVERDELIVER. 👌🏼

اینجا فاکتورایی که
‌ “من” برام مهمه برای اینکه چطور برای بار اول به یه آنلاین شاپ اعتماد میکنم رو میگم 👇🏻
‌
1️⃣ مهم ترین چیز از نظر من 
اینه که اون آنلاین شاپ محصولاتی که تازه برای فروش گذاشته شدن ( از برندای مختلف ) بیاره
مثلا کانسیلر فنتی بیوتی تازه برای فروش گذاشته شده میبینم اون آنلاین شاپ سفارش میگیره یا نه
یا یه مدت که گذشت ازش موجود میاره 
البته کانسیلر اینجا مثاله و هر محصول از هر برند معتبری میتونه باشه
‌
2️⃣ یه سری برندها چون خیلی لوکس هستن یا چون خاصن تقریبا فیکشون تولید نمیشه
یا من ندیدم
مثل ناتاشا دنونا یا پت مک گریث
بعضی از پک های سفورا
یا همین صابون ابرو و ....
دقت میکنم ببینم اون آنلاین شاپ ازین برندها هم میاره یا نه
‌
3️⃣ فاکتور خرید یا لایو و استوری در مورد خریدشون
‌
4️⃣ کسایی که ازشون خرید کردنو حجم محصولاتی که میارن
‌‌
5️⃣ محصولات متنوع بیارن و اینکه اینستا یا تلگرامشون فعال باشه
عکس و فیلم از سفارشهایی که میارن هم بذارن
‌ ‌ ‼️ یه نکته مهم اینه که قیمت گذاریشونم برام مهمه 
کسی که تو قیمت گذاشتن انصاف نداره 
تو موارد دیگه هم میتونه انصاف نداشته باشه؛ مثل همینکه یه محصول شکسته تحویل شما بده ‼️
_________
‌
حالا چنتا نکته مهم:
اگه آنلاین شاپ فقط فاکتور خرید بده کافیه؟ از نظر من نه چون از کجا معلوم همون جنس رو تحویل بده
‌
آیا اینکه چنتا بلاگر معرفیشون کرده باشن چی؟ با احترام به همه ی همکارهای خودم ، اما به نظرم خودتون هم تحقیق کنین 
چون بارها شده جایی تبلیغ شده یا فیک فروش بودن
یا محصولات تاریخ گذشته و ... برای فروش گذاشتن
‌
نکته بعدی اینکه ماها نمیتونیم هر ساعت و هرروز و همیشه تمام آنلاین شاپ ها رو چک کنیم و در جریان تمام امور کاریشون باشیم
‌
، شاید کسی با یه آنلاین شاپ دعواش بشه و اون آنلاین شاپ سفارش اون فرد رو نده در اینصورت بلاگری که معرفی کرده مقصره؟ یا یه محصولی رو آنلاین شاپ شکسته یا تاریخ گذشته تحویل بده؟
چون برای اینکار هیچ نظارتی نیست 
متاسفانه نمیشه اینجور مسائلو پیش بینی کرد
منم بارها گفتم تو اینجور مسائل من چون تو جریان تمام جزئیات نیستم نمیتونم قضاوت کنم ‌پس خودتونم حسابی تحقیق کنین
و پیشنهادم اینه که برای بار اول 
خرید زیاد نکنین
‌
چون پیش اومده کسی از جایی ملیونی خرید کرده و بعدش اون آنلاین شاپ تماما محصولات فیک بهش داده

از فردا هم آنلاین شاپ های مورد اعتماد خودمو استوری میکنم

I’m just a few short weeks away from having the freedom to swim shirtless. I wouldn’t say I feel jealous or resentful of Biff— cisgender men have their own burdens that I wouldn’t wish to bear. I’ve always just accepted that there are some things that he can do that I cannot.
.
Soon... at least one of those things will change. I’ll be able to use the men’s locker room instead of a private stall. I’ll be able to swim without a shirt on. To walk around the house without a shirt on. To sleep in bed without a shirt on. To wear white shirts and tank tops and v-necks. To have one less reminder that there are parts of my body that cause others to stare and tease and judge and malign. To have one more thing to feel joyful about.
.
It can seem so simple— especially to those who don’t have bodies that our culture deems acceptable. It can seem silly to be so impacted by others’ opinions that you have actual surgery to look different. But at the end of the day you just have to trust people when they say “I need to do this.” Whether it’s to wear the right clothes or feel at home in their body or not feel suicidal or swim shirtless in Iceland... trust people when they say they need this. It hasn’t even been two weeks and I can say I feel so different in my body. Despite the pain and the meds and the swelling and the bruising... it’s all been completely worth it.
.

Some people feel empowered when they put on a bikini but others get the same feeling from yoga pants. It's all individual and that's okay. Life brings a lot of unexpected twists + turns........ some bring us to the best of places, while others drops us at locations we never thought we’d be in. 🤷🏾‍♀️ I believe a lot of us (statistically 3 out of 5) would agree that the SHOCK of grinding it out every single day of the week for 8-12 hours a day wouldn’t be enough to do all the things you want to do, need to do, and/or dream of doing. It’s simply not.
•
And, because 50% of marriages end in divorce (hello.), we have an influx of households that are “making it” off of one income & POSSIBLY some extra. Those three families that are having a hard time making ends meet, aren’t only one parent households... that number also includes two folks working day in and out, exhausted, missing events + field trips, grumpy, struggling with health issues, too! I definitely wouldn’t say that is the “American Dream” or  what we thought life would be growing up & even after graduating college!
•
Bottom line..... we NEED more. Not out of greed, out of necessity. Out of priority. 
We need more time with our spouses. 
We need better health. 
We need more energy to get through the day. 
We need more margin to comfortably take care of life.
We need more control over what we eat. 
We need more understanding of gut health & how it affects our emotional + physical health.
•
And, we need to be a lot more honest about what we need so that we can be a lot bolder about doing what we need to do to get what we need to have! 
Why are you shame?! Listen to the people around you!! They’re all struggling with something YOU may be able to help them with - if you said YES to something that may be a little different but has the potential to provide well for your family. Be a catalyst for change + let’s do something about what’s happening withIn our homes + bodies TOGETHER!!! 👯‍♂️🤳🏾

I was scheduled for an induction for 7 PM on the 8th. My mom was suppose to be at our house in one hour to watch the girls and I refused to call her any sooner. Then they came to be 3 minutes apart and INTENSE so Brook made the call, She came rushing over and off we went. The nurses put me in room # 1 (What they call the quick room) laid out the labour supplies table and turned on the bed warmer. I finally got the epidural, We waited and that’s when things took a turn for the worse. Babes heart rate was constantly high so they broke my water to get things moving and noticed that poo came out, Ivy had pooped inside my stomach and the doctor said we would need to monitor her more closely. Long story short-After inserting a heart rate monitor in her head and breaking my water I wasn’t progressing past 6 cm and more poo came out with each cervix check. Ivy’s heart rate was high and they were concerned. It all happened so quickly after that, We needed to get her out and we needed to get her out quick. I signed the c section papers and was so numb to the emotions-So scared for what was about to happen. The doctor told me we will have a special team at the delivery since she had pooped inside my stomach, He said sometimes they inhale the poo but this only happens to 3% of babies so not to worry-It was just a precaution. I looked to my right and there she was lying on the bed completely limp with doctors swarming her. I was screaming at the top of my lungs and no one would respond, I yelled for Brook to tell me everything was ok and he didn’t. 🍁🍇 Se penso a quando Orlando e Vittorio erano senza nemmeno un dentino mi prende un senso di nostalgia immenso!
Quei bacetti bavosi e morbidosi rimarranno scolpiti nella mia memoria per sempre e saranno ricordi dolcissimi di momenti brevi e faticosi, ma ricchi di amore e gioia condivisa!
Come già vi raccontavo, l’attesa del primo dentino, sia per Orlando che per Vittorio, è stata lunga e anche un po’ sofferta, sia da parte mia che dei miei parenti, in gran parte odontoiatri.
Ho massaggiato le gengive dei miei bambini con grande regolarità per stimolare la fuoriuscita dei dentini e alleviare i loro fastidi…
Ho utilizzato molti prodotti tra cui il miele rosato per togliere loro i dolori che comporta l’uscita dei primi dentini e devo dire che tutto sommato ce la siamo e ce la stiamo cavando bene!
Orlando ormai ha moltissimi dentini, quasi tutti quelli da latte, e Vittorio mi fa troppo sorridere con i suoi due incisivi inferiori e i suoi quattro denti in uscita nell’arcata superiore!
Ricordo ancora come mio padre fosse attento ad ogni nuovo dentino dei miei fratelli e ancora porto stampato nella mente il ricordo del cartello appeso in camera mia con la scritta: “Fila a lavarti i denti”
Allora non davo peso a quelle parole ,ma mi rendo conto solo ora quanto fosse efficace e quanto mi serva ora da monito quando, per pigrizia, anche solo penso di non lavare i denti prima di dormire!...continua sul blog (link nella bio) vi aspetto!🍇🍁

My elementary school was having a field trip to see ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’. I held out until the morning of the trip to tell my mom and tried to get her to sign the permission slip. She told me that I was not going to see “no movie and watching no witchcraft, bringing those spirits in her house.” 🙄😅 However, my mom had this thing she did when I was growing up - she would always practice her signature anywhere she saw paper. 😏 Let’s just say, I also liked to practice tracing her signature whenever I saw it written. 📝 Later that day, I came home from school and she asked about my day. I told her that they had us in the library watching ‘A Land Before Time’ because I couldn’t go on the field trip. 🤫 She walked away shaking her head in approval while talking to my aunt Barbara about how no school gonna introduce her kids to them demons. (GIRL!) 🙄🙈😂 Whole time, my goofy ass was telling myself: “Just wait, wait until I get my Hogwarts letter in the mail. I’m gonna be out of this damn house for good. I’m a damn witch.” 😂 Decades later I confessed to not only forging her signature and going on the trip, I told her that the bars on my bunk bed held all the books I would sneak and read; including every single Harry Potter book. 🤣😂😝 #GotEm! #SheWasSuperMad #ExpectoPatronumHerAss #TouchMeAndIWillRunAway #SheHadFireInHerEyes

Vi vet at det sikreste er å sitte bakovervendt så lenge som mulig, men det er ikke alltid ting går slik man ønsker. Av helsemessige og personlige årsaker ble det slik. Og da er det veldig flott at det finnes en slik bilstol som nettopp dette. Besafe izi flex er et framovervendt sete, som er godkjent og egnet for barn mellom 4-12 år, eller fra 100-150cm langt. Et flott sete til de barna som er litt lange i bena og trenger større plass, og samtidig som sitter framovervendt. Stolen kan tilpasses barnets lengde, slik at det blir riktig stilt. På setet medfølger det en PAD+ som kan festes på beltet slik at det gir ytterligere beskyttelse ved haken og brystet. Det er også fleksibel sidebeskyttelse, og setet er uten armlener for å unngå feilbruk da feilplasserte hoftebelter kan føre til alvorlige skader i magen. Bilstolen kan justeres i to sittestillinger, og ryggstøtten kan også vinkles uavhengig fra hvilestillingen for å passe ulike bilseter. “If it won’t matter in 5 years, don’t spend more than 5 minutes being upset about it.”
•••
I believe that stress begins & ends with how we respond to a difficult situation. We don’t always have control over what happens to us, but what we can control is our response to stress. The next time a tough moment happens, stop and take a moment to remind yourself “I can give into this and let stress get the better of me, or I can resist an impulsive harsh reaction”. Easier said sometimes than done right?
•••
I don’t sweat the small stuff anymore. While I was pregnant with Will I learned this the hard way, because nothing gets accomplished if you allow stress to consume you. My SPD left me physically unable to do normal everyday activities, my hormones were crazy, I was busier work-wise than I had ever been in my life. All I wanted to do was stay in bed, but I had two toddlers depending on me and I couldn’t allow stress to get the better of me. I made the best out of a difficult situation and I’m now a better person because of it.

Maska neobsahuje permanentní pigmenty, takže se snadno vymývá, ale balení je natolik velké, že vám vystačí pořádně dlouho 😻

Hace unos días comencé a usar esta linda cadenita de @gabysalazarjewelry que representa a mis dos hijos. Los niños son muy observadores, así que el día que me la puse mi hijo la notó inmediatamente.
Hemos hablado mucho en casa de la llegada de su hermanito, y es increíble ver como poco a poco lo ha ido absorbiendo e introduciendo a su rutina. Pero lo que quería contarleses que al verla, mi hijo fijó su mirada en ella unos segundos y luego continuó con lo que estaba haciendo. Sin embargo, a los minutos, comenzó a enojarse por todo, a llorar, a "pelear" con nosotros etc. Yo le dije a mi esposo: "él me vio la cadenita, la observó detenidamente, por eso está así".
Los niños de esa edad, están aprendiendo a gestionar sus emociones y pensamientos, por lo que fuimos a su cama, nos abrazamos y le dije mientras sollozaba "todo va a estar bien, aquí estoy". A lo que él me respondió separando su cuerpo del mío y señalando la cadenita: "¿Quiénes están alli mami?". Por supuesto que él lo sabía, pero necesitaba que alguien más lo verbalizara,  por lo que contesté: "Tú y Mauro, mi amor". Lloró un rato más, y pasó el resto del día un poco sensible, pero como siempre decimos con Jose: "en esta casa no le tenemos miedo a las grandes emociones".
Al día siguiente, no lo voy a negar, dudé en ponerme nuevamente la cadenita. Pensé: "le voy a dar más tiempo"; pero a la vez, confié en mi hijo y sabía que él había tenido la descarga emocional y la resignificación necesaria para absorber lo que había ocurrido.
Ahora, le encanta cuando la tengo puesta y siento que -sin querer- se convirtió en una gran ayuda en este proceso de transición que está viviendo ♡. #joyfulmamas #thehappynow #thepursuitofjoyproject

Neu bei mir eingezogen sind diese beiden Produkte aus der @toofaced Tutti Frutti LE. Bei den Verpackungen hat sich @toofaced wieder selbst übertroffen und wirklich schöne Verpackungen hergestellt. Ein Grund, weshalb ich zugeschlagen habe und eine Lidschattenpalette und ein Highlight/ Bronzer Duo mitdurften. Außerdem gab es damals 25% Rabatt auf das ganze Sephora Sortiment, was ich ausnutzen wollte.
Heute wollte ich euch aber nur die „Sparkling Pineapple“ Lidschattenpalette vorstellen. Die Lidschattenpalette enthält 7 Farben, von matt, metallische bis glitzernde Töne. Die ganze Palette riecht nach Ananas 🍍, der Duft ist aber nicht so stark und verfliegt schnell. Ich habe mir die Palette, wegen der Farbauswahl und dem schönem grün Ton zugelegt. Besonders den grün Ton und der letzte helle Ton finde ich schwierig. Dagegen ist der glitzer Gold Ton sehr gut pigmentiert. Ich muss sie jedenfalls am Wochenende noch mal ganz genau unter die Lupe nehmen und weiter rum experimentieren.

When I tell y’all about the hardest things I have been through as a trans person, you believe me. And I appreciate that. I don’t need to to bring receipts every time— I am shown empathy and love and support. Which is how it should be.
.
Yet I can’t help but juxtapose my own experiences of marginalization against those of my friends of color. I see them share stories of overt racism, and their followers virtually trip over each other in their rush to find a Perfectly Logical Explanation for their experience. And if the experience of racism is more subtle? They are accused of being “too sensitive.” Of reading too much into things. Of seeing racism everywhere.
.
It is lovely to be trusted. To be believed. I thank you all so much for the faith you put in me to let you into my life authentically and with integrity. I work to earn and keep your trust every day. And I hope you extend that same open spirit to others who share their stories of marginalization, including others who don’t express things as delicately or gently as I do. I’ve had many privileges that allow me to process things with grace, and not everyone has been as fortunate as I have.
.
Trust us. We are telling you stories.

caption: So yesterday I cut @therealb_starr #naturalhair back to #wakandaforever and we had a discussion about loving yourself and not giving a shit about what others think. So it prompted me to make this post. The first picture is me modeling make up, the second picture is me without make up and pretty much how I look 95% of the time, the third picture is a side-by-side of me and me wearing the absolute most make up I will put on myself. And the last picture is pretty much what I would wear if I was going on a night out on the town. Any other time you see me with a lot of make up, and make up artist has done it and it’s some sort of event that I am going to.A lot of times I may fill in my eyebrows and wear a tinted lipgloss to go kick it and that is it. For one I don’t have time for the responsibility of wearing make up. You can’t scratch your face without the shit getting under your  nails and you sure as hell can’t forget and hug people and get make up all over their clothing. Moreover, I can’t stand how dirty my rags look once I wash my face, and how my face pretty much breaks out every time I wear all of that foundation and shit. Wearing make up, using filters, and adding other “accessories” should just be something fun to do; not a your way of life and a bridge to self esteem. As a stylist I know all too well the insecurities that some women carry.  It is sad to go through life struggling to look in the mirror at yourself and your friends, family, or man haven’t a clue of what you really look like. I have talked to several women who said their boyfriends or husbands have not seen their real hair 🤭 it is either in a #wig #sewin or some type of #braids and a bonnet if they don’t have any of the aforementioned in. Whatever issues you are having you need to dig down deep maybe get a therapist and find out the root cause of it and get back to loving yourself. I’m sure that is equivalent to walking around stressed out AF because you’re always on edge about what someone thinks about your appearance. It’s always a good time to drop the veil n say FUCK IT and live in YOUR TRUTH! I swear you will attract the most #genuine and #REAL beings out here.  #selflove #selfdiscovery

A que adora ser "do contra" só pq simplesmente quer fazer aquilo que tem vontade, quer viver de acordo com aquilo que acredita e que cada vez mais tem coragem de dizer não e de lutar pelo o que é certo. A que vai confrontar tudo e todos que estiverem fazendo mal seja pra quem for. A que vai continuar levando muita pedrada, mas vai guardá-las pra continuar construindo seu castelinho. A que vai seguir cada vez mais seu próprio coração, doa o que doer, incomode a quem incomodar. Que venham todas as glórias e todas as lágrimas de 2018, todas as alegrias e tristezas, todos os aprendizados, não importando a forma que venham, eu quero é aprender mais! E gratidão por tudo meu Deus, nada é em vão! 🖤

Ogni tanto vorrei essere ancora più paziente di quanto sono, vorrei essere una mamma migliore, meno ansiosa, più spartana...poi vedo mio figlio e credo che alla fine vada bene come sto facendo...
Quante emozioni nell’essere mamma...chissà cosa penserò a rileggermi fra qualche anno...

Being a parent is mostly just learning to recalibrate your goals. Ideally, Riley wouldn’t get so depressed that he mopes around all the time and tells us everything he imagines is wrong with our house. Ideally he would be happy and well-adjusted, able to bounce back after disappointment and eager to contribute to our household. But those are dreams that would work for a kid without his unique struggles, so we adjust.
.
Sunday nights are hard. He loves the weekends because the structure of school is challenging for him. Tonight he started to spiral, slowly ramping up the panic as he realized that Monday is fast approaching. He started whining about math, drilling me on what my attitude about math was when I was his age. He bemoaned the number of days until next weekend, complaining about how dumb he is and how bad his school is (he’s not and it’s not). He started to get stuck, obsessing over things that simply aren’t true.
.
Then, lo and behold, he took a deep breath and said, “Dads? I’m feeling down and stressed out about the weekend ending and I need help.”
.
It was the first real moment of self-awareness I’ve seen from him in a long time. Maybe ever. I called him over and offered him a place against my shoulder as I read Percy Jackson to Hailey. I rubbed his back and he curled up against me like he did when he was little. He cried softly, like a letting-out of anxiety, and when Hailey went to bed he said, “I feel better now.” And we took some silly selfies to help distract him.
.
There are days when I don’t know what “perfect” would even look like. What a day would be where we didn’t have to pick him up and hear stories about his tantrums and panic attacks and emotional meltdowns. Where we could have a nice family dinner without him lashing out or making inappropriate jokes or complaining about everything. I can’t imagine what that would even be like. But tonight I saw a glimpse of what “better” could look like. And I liked it. I liked it a lot.
.

Sempre tive problemas com esse corpo, com as estrias, com a “pancinha” persistente, peitos longe de serem redondinhos e firmes, muito menos grandes.
É aquele negócio de consumir a vida inteira aquela imagem de mulher magra, pele perfeita, estria nunca e peitos fartos e no lugarzinho; então quando se é pré adolescente e muitas vezes ainda criança, aquilo começa a comer a sua mente, te quebra inteira, pedacinho por pedacinho.
Já chorei, já deixei de comer, já pesei bem menos do que deveria (BEM menos), já desejei loucamente um corpo magro e sem estrias, já pensei em por silicone e ainda penso, já me mutilei de tantas formas, tudo pra não ter esse corpo aí.
O processo de amar nosso corpo é duro demais, às vezes é impossível, mas no “fim” tudo vale a pena.
As vezes rola umas recaídas, mas logo eu me corrijo e olho pro espelho e penso “gostosona da porra, deliciosa, deusabençoe viado” e tento parar de me machucar.
Nunca pensei na possibilidade de tirar fotos de lingerie e mostrar minhas estrias, sempre me barrei. Hoje, olhando as fotos que tirei com essa lingerie incrível que a @letitbeintimate me mandou, vejo que eu não preciso me envergonhar de nada que tá ali, pq eu sei que é completamente aceitável todas as marquinhas desse meu corpão e elas são quem eu sou, me completam e fazem parte de mim; mostram todo o meu processo de dor e sofrimento pra chegar na grandeza que eu cheguei, de amor próprio, de felicidade!
Quero agradecer muito ao @felipe.watanabe por ter feito esse ensaio incrível e por ter deixado tudo completamente como é 💛🌿
Sou grata a muitas pessoas que me ajudaram nesse processo de aceitação, muito obrigada mesmo!
Vamo ter orgulho de nós mesmos bbs, nosso corpão é nosso e o que os outros pensam não define quem nós somos! 🌹✨

Sustain發熱背心/圍巾
讓你暖呼呼過冬

在德國只要進入秋季，就開始冷到不行，
更別說進入冬季後，可怕的冷風加上下雪
讓我這個台灣來的異鄉人每次都凍到受不了，
反正出去就是全副武裝，
手套、帽子、大衣以及靴子缺一不可，
但其實有時候穿再多還是超級冷，
這時候就好想念暖暖包，
但德國哪來的暖暖包？
我是沒看過，有也特別貴，
而且之前在台灣還特地買了帶回德國，
但因為太重又不能重複使用就放棄，
我常常在想
如果衣服自己可以發熱就太棒了，
沒想到台灣人的創意無限，
真的發明了圍巾和背心
跟行動電源做結合的發熱衣物。
真的是太神奇了。

超薄的背心和圍巾放進行動電源，
按下按鈕亮起白光，
15秒後就有42°C的溫度，
再輕按一下，轉換為黃光，
就會加熱到46°C，
超級暖和，不用擔心會過熱，
加熱60分鐘後還會自動斷電，
行動電源非常輕薄，也很容易攜帶，
裝在背心和圍巾裡面也不會有異物感，
這下就不怕穿得超級擁腫，
只要外套裡面套件背心或是圍巾就夠，
隨時隨地都給你暖呼呼的感受，
前幾天我帶著圍巾聖誕市集的時候，
真的很像一個會發熱的行動小暖爐，
超級舒服的，再冷也不怕，
阿班試穿背心也跟我說，
這背心超級新潮，簡單的剪裁，
輕薄材質真的很好穿，
搭配什麼衣服都適合。

SUSTAIN發熱背心和圍巾： 
擁有台灣研發專利的發熱片技術
台灣研發專利發熱片通過美國UL電熱產品認證、CE認證，低電壓、耐用，兼具均溫、防水功能，這超強機能的發熱片只有0.05毫米
每一組SUSTAIN發熱圍巾裡面都有附上延長線、防塵蓋、行動電源。
使用自己的行動電源也沒問題。
不管是騎車、運動或是旅遊都好穿搭，也方便收納。

#therealmomseries we may look like besties in this picture, but most days I feel like we’re frenemies 🤣 let’s talk about mom identity. My life these days is so MOM. like mom mom mom mom mom. Constantly being needed, and still never feeling like there’s enough to give. Snacks all day, enforcing boundaries, breaking up fights, giving time outs, fighting for at least someone to take some kind of nap, and rarely a moment of thanks or appreciation. It is so easy to lose yourself and feel isolated. Like at least once a week (sometimes more 🙈) my kids drive me to tears because I feel so frustrated and overwhelmed by repeating myself all.day.long. Not to mention feeling trapped at home sometimes because someone is sick, or something needs cleaning, or nap times don’t overlap. So how do we find ourselves in something as overwhelming and all consuming as motherhood? Did you guys know I used to paint? I’m not sure I was any good, but I enjoyed it. I used to love to read too. I would go to the bookstore for hours, just people watching and reading book covers. I also love music. I have a vinyl collection and used to love going to small venues to see new artists. These are all the things I dreamt about passing on to my kids. MY passions. MY dreams. Shared hobbies. Don’t forget who you were before you were mom. Find a way to take what you loved then and share it with your kids. Whatever recharges you and fuels you-It might be on hold for now, but it won’t be forever. So if you feel swallowed up by motherhood and feel like you’re drowning, you are not alone. I love being a mom, but damn sometimes do I miss just being me.

С време търпение и опити можете да накарате всяка една палитра "да работи".. но за мен качествените сенки за очи трябва да работят без усилие. Трябва да се преливат с няколко движения и да не трябва дълго наслагване и преливане, за да изглеждат така както искам. 😊 За да дам разбираема аналогия, тъй като мненията за козметика като цяло са много субективни - родителите ми са ми разказвали, че едно време с техния автомобил Москвич са стигали до морето за 6-7 часа (от Пловдив), защото колата не е кожела да се движи с повече от 80-90 км/ч, а и е трябвало да спират и за почивки често, защото моторът е прегрявал, било e и много топло в колата, понеже е нямало климатик. Стигали ли са до морето? Да!. Било ли им е супер хубаво на морето? Да, разбира се! Но днес пътят от Пловдив до морето се минава за 2 часа и половина, защото автомобилите се движат с много по-висока скорост, имат климатици и прегряват много по-рядко. 朋友幫我訂到很讚的親子餐廳
就在東區延吉街的巷子裡，
其實我對親子餐廳的印象
就是東西普遍不是很好吃，
只要孩子覺得好玩就可以，
但這間親子餐廳還滿讓我驚豔的，
食物超級好吃，除了西式的麵食
還有韓式料理：拌飯、年糕和炸雞，
光食物就讓我吃得超開心，
環境呢，就是非常乾淨舒服，
玩具精緻又多樣化，
像是粉紅球池、騎士城堡、超市廚房、
變裝區以及互動式銀幕丟球區，
光這幾樣就可以讓小班班發洩體力，
玩到不想吃飯，
更別說那兩面的玫瑰花牆和梳妝沙發區，
讓爸媽小孩都拍得很開心，
每個人馬上變身成網美，
另外還有大加分的嬰兒
爬爬爬地墊遊戲區，
讓小湯包可以盡情滾滾滾踢踢踢。

整體來說，是間很棒的親子餐廳，
服務也很好，
因為小班班進去後就認識新朋友，
然後飯也不吃，
一直玩到人家休息還不肯走，
他們開到晚上8點半，
但讓我們拖到9點才慢慢離開，
也沒有催促我們，
好笑的是小子突然跟其他小朋友變好友，
拍照的時候兩個剛認識的小朋友也來一起拍，
走的時侯還難捨難分，超可愛的...
話說連人家名字都不知道耶

Sassy Bethany is here with us today & she wanted to share a little PSA on -
“Things you should never say to a pregnant woman.” 🤰🏻
_____________________
1️⃣Guessing how far along someone is. ➡️ It’s like offering to guess how much someone weighs. Do you want someone guessing you’re 20 lbs over your actual weight? Didn’t think so. Best not to comment on a pregnant woman’s size no matter what stage of pregnancy she’s at. 
_____________________
2️⃣Are you sure you should be eating/drinking that? ➡️ Trust us. We’ve asked our doctor about coffee/what cheeses are safe. We appreciate your “concern” but having strangers monitor your every food/drink intake can drive us cray cray.
_____________________
3️⃣“You look tired” 🤦🏻‍♀️
_____________________
4️⃣Making judgements about a mother’s birth plan. ➡️ Every mother is different. Every birth is different. Home birth/Epidural/Planned C-Section/Water Birth - Your “perfect” birth plan is probably not the same as the next mother’s and that’s fine. It doesn’t make yours any better or worse or give a right for you to judge. 
_____________________
5️⃣Assuming that a mother is “disappointed” in the gender. ➡️ Telling a mother with 2/3/4 children of the same gender to “try again” is not only completely insensitive but just straight up rude. Go discuss your obsession with gender with a mother who’s having a hard time conceiving. You’ll get checked real quick. 👋🏼 A healthy baby is a blessing. 
_____________________
6️⃣ “Was it planned?” 🤦🏻‍♀️
_____________________
7️⃣“Don’t you think 3/4/5 is too much?”

在德國的冬天其實非常難帶孩子出門，
因為室內有暖氣，室外又冷到一個不行，
常常外面穿很多，進到裡面就得脫一堆，
所以小班班小的時候就是這樣常常感冒，
現在阿母我學乖了，
有種冷真的是阿母覺得你冷，
嬰兒體溫超級高，如果老是包的緊緊的，
其實他們很不舒服，
現在小湯包在家
就只是一件簡單的連身衣，
外出只加個外套和帽子，
再蓋個溫暖的棉被，就很足夠了，
選件好用的棉被比穿多的衣服更重要，
冬暖夏涼，還不能太過厚重，
就是這樣我跟他愛上了手工樂樂被。

這件的Hush Baby手工樂樂被非常實用，
它一面是使用色彩繽紛的純棉布，
有著可愛的圖案，
另面是用柔軟顆粒觸感的絨毛布當表布，
內裡夾層則是使用透氣雙層紗，
透氣又保暖，
我在家裡用的時候，開了暖氣，
小湯包蓋著不會悶出整身汗，
在外面使用的時候，
厚度又剛剛好讓身體保持溫度，
所以這件厲害的樂樂毯除了好看之外，
功能性也很強，
小班班就喜歡抱著樂樂被在沙發看書，
小湯包則是看著樂樂被可愛的圖案，
然後一直咬一直捏一直摸，
心想怎麽那麼舒服啊，
重點還是每件樂樂被都是用手工縫製的，
手工之精細，讓我很驚豔！

它有兩種尺寸，
一種是小張一點的雙色小魔毯，
可以當成推車毯以及尿布墊使用，

以及鋪在推車當成椅墊，
雙色設計加上流蘇，超級好看的，
另款是加大尺寸樂樂被
當成小棉被，在家在外面都可以，
天氣稍微冷一點
我就是讓小湯包蓋樂樂被出去，
可愛的樂樂被已經被無數路人詢問過
在哪裡買的，我都會很驕傲的說，

How to: 
Mist hair with @biolage R.A.W. Texture Spray and wave sections of hair with @hottoolspro Curl Bar Set using 1 1/2in wand for movement and flow. 
Take horseshoe section at crown and backcomb slightly for volume. Take that crown section and make a soft twist and secure with bobby pins. Take a section from right behind the ear on each side and clip away. Take rest of hair from the back and put in a ponytail and loop ends in to create a bun shape. Take each left over section from each side and softly twist away from the face towards the bun and secure with bobby pin. Finish off with @Biolage Blue Agave Freeze Fix Spray➡️ Can be purchased @saloncentric .

for a hundred miles through the desert repenting.

Meanwhile the world goes on.
Meanwhile the sun and the clear pebbles of the rain
are moving across the landscapes,
over the prairies and the deep trees,
the mountains and the rivers.
Meanwhile the wild geese, high in the clean blue air,
are heading home again.
Whoever you are, no matter how lonely,
the world offers itself to your imagination,
calls to you like the wild geese, harsh and exciting -
over and over announcing your place
in the family of things.
